method.phase_a: POST /api/sessions only (no inference, no credits) to read modelDowngraded/effectiveModel
method.phase_b: one deterministic inference per id requiring an exact token back
method.pass_criterion: exact-token answer AND chars>0 AND create response carried no modelDowngraded/effectiveModel AND final status=stopped
method.positive_control: gpt-5.5 and claude-opus-4-8 through the identical harness returned the downgrade flags, while honest ids returned only {sessionId}. conol emits those fields solely on downgrade, so their absence is a clean verdict, not missing data.
method.id_spellings: authoritative values from gateway.py CONOL_MODEL_MAP; wrong spellings yield a 201 + sessionId and then zero assistant text, which looks like an unavailable model
